article.hook: Words can feel like a weightlifting session you didn’t sign up for. When Saturn moves through Gemini, conversations don’t just flow - they demand precision and proof.
article.lived: Over the next two and a half years, we patch together scattered thoughts into tight sentences. Meetings stretch longer as we double-check facts and phrase every point with care. You might notice emails rewritten until the meaning is exactly right or find yourself pressing pause before speaking, weighing each word’s impact.
article.turn: The edge cuts when caution turns into silence or debates become battlegrounds for who’s right. Rigid thinking and over-skepticism can trap curiosity under a pile of ‘what ifs.’ Speak fully or don’t speak at all, but don’t let your own mind become a locked door.
moves: Draft your next message out loud before sending it to catch weak spots.
Schedule a weekly time to read something challenging and take notes on your thoughts.
Ask for feedback on one conversation where you held back and explore what stopped you.
